subject: Human Evolution
title: The Species Problem
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Species Problem.

hook.text: How many species are in our family tree? Ask ten paleoanthropologists and you'll get ten answers.

buildup.text: 'Splitters' see many species from subtle bone differences. 'Lumpers' see one variable population.

discovery.text: Dmanisi's five skulls from one site vary as much as skulls from different 'species' found elsewhere.

twist.text: If living humans showed that much variation in fossils, future scientists might call us three species.

climax.text: The debate matters: species counts shape how we understand evolution's pace and branching pattern.

punchline.text: Naming species is part science, part argument.

quiz.question: What is the 'splitter vs. lumper' debate about?
options: How to split fossils for study
Whether fossil variations represent different species or one
